parties.respondent: The Bihar State Food and Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd. & Ors

summary: Procurement of Custom Milled Rice (CMR) under Bihar and Orissa Public Demands Recovery Act, 1914; dispute over rice millers' obligation to supply CMR to FCI depots; contractual non-acceptance of delivery by FCI leading to recovery proceedings; recovery certificates issued for dues ranging from Rs. 26,28,780/- to Rs. 9,91,29,305/-; lead cases Sone Valley Rice Mill v. State of Bihar, Pawapuri Rice Mills v. Civil Supplies Corporation; standard of review in intra-court appeal; preponderance of evidence in revenue recovery proceedings.
legal_provisions_cited: Bihar and Orissa Public Demands Recovery Act, 1914
Bihar and Orissa Public Demands Recovery Rules
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; dismissal restored.
